name: There's a pretty girl on the subway
source:
She has merch of like 3 different things you are also into. You keep staring at her. You wanna talk to her so bad.. Are you gonna say hi or look like a creep until she notices you?

[From [url=https://starryeyedess.itch.io/theres-a-pretty-girl-on-the-subway]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她身上挂着大概3个你也超喜欢的同款周边。你一直忍不住盯着她看，特别想上前搭话……你是打算主动打声招呼，还是像个怪人一样死盯着看，直到被她发现？

[摘自[url=https://starryeyedess.itch.io/theres-a-pretty-girl-on-the-subway]itch.io[/url]]
